editorial:
Imagine waking up a century from now in a world that is totally dull but somehow also violent. That is exactly where you find Tom, a guy who is just completely over it. He has reached a point where he is so bored and stressed that he wants to quit his job, except there is one big problem: he has no idea what his job actually is. You will love how the movie captures that feeling of being stuck in a weird system where nobody gives you a straight answer. The vibe is a quirky mix of sci-fi and dry humor that makes the futuristic setting feel strangely familiar, like a bad day at a corporate office multiplied by a thousand.

What really works here is the pacing and the funny way Tom interacts with the people around him who insist that leaving is impossible. While the special effects are a bit dated since it is from 1980, it adds a certain charm to the experience. If you enjoy weird comedies with a bit of a social message, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Tom finally discovers the truth about his role in society. He finds out that he is actually part of a giant machine designed to keep the city running, and his boredom was just a side effect of the system. In the end, he manages to break free from the loop. He chooses his own freedom over the comfort of a job he never understood, leaving the strange city behind for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird retro sci-fi and stories about quitting a bad job.
